study.name: Retest: Phase 2d: H5 Negative Text Treatment — Track 2 (brief-text)
study.description:
Tests 3 exclusion guidance levels (Minimal, Terse, Verbose) at the
carried-forward brief-text (text-only) M/E with T=0.0.

This is a text-only analogue of the preregistered H5 test. Since no
example images are sent, the exclusion guidance is purely instructional
— it tells the model what NOT to detect based on visual descriptions,
without reference image anchoring.

Minimal is the Phase 2b Track 2 T=0.0 baseline. Terse adds a brief
"do not mark" list. Verbose adds detailed per-type exclusion criteria.

See Decision 16 (dual-track), Decision 17 (Phase 2d design).
study.retest_notes: H5 negative text Track 2 (text-only). All at T=0.0.
